phaseCaption: From the first hello to a lasting connection.
supportText: One workspace. Every business. A little more possibility.
welcomeSub: Bring your businesses, people, and conversations together.
setupSub: A few small steps to get your workspace ready.
stepOneSub: Your home for people and conversations.
stepTwoSub: Give the right people the right access.
stepThreeSub: Bring in an existing business number.
stepFourSub: Check that messages reach the right business.
networkSub: A clear view of the people you work with.
activitySub: The latest changes in your workspace.
noActivitySub: Business and team updates will appear as you get set up.
nextText: Open the inbox to reply to customers and keep track of their requests.
agenciesSub: Each business has its own team, numbers, and private conversations.
emptyAgenciesSub: Add a business to get started.
teamTitle: Good work starts with good teams.
teamSub: Invite your people and keep access scoped to the right business.
roleHelp: Administrators manage the team and connections. Agents can reply and update customer details. Viewers have read-only access.
connectionSub: Connect existing WhatsApp Business Platform numbers to their businesses.
webhookHelp: In your Meta app, configure this callback and subscribe to the messages field. For an existing integration, review its current callback before changing it.
connectionNote: Credentials are encrypted. Numbers are verified with Meta before they can be saved. Real messages appear only after webhook setup.
settingsTitle: The details that make it yours.
settingsSub: Your profile, preferences, and workspace foundation.
languageHelp: Choose the language for your workspace.
securityText: Staff only see businesses they belong to. WhatsApp credentials are encrypted, and incoming events require a valid Meta signature.
scopeText: A shared inbox, automatic customer insights, opt-in profiles, and relevant offers.
demoReadOnly: This is a read-only tour. Sign in to make changes.
name: Full name
signInSub: Your businesses. Your people. All in one place.
signInFoot: Access is by invitation. Ask your workspace administrator for an invite.
signInError: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your details and try again.
heroText: One workspace for shops, salons, clinics, travel companies, and more. Bring your team and customer conversations together.
heroFooter: From the first hello to a lasting connection.
inviteSub: Create your account to join the business that invited you.
inviteSuccess: You’re in. Sign in with your email and password to continue.
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Example: zagros-home
inviteHelp: This creates a private, single-use link that expires in 48 hours. Share it with your teammate through your usual channel.
inviteLinkHelp: Copy this link now. It won’t be shown again after closing.
metaHelp: Use the existing business’s Cloud API credentials. Get the IDs from Meta Business settings. These secrets are never shown to other team members.

errors.invalidInput: Check the fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission for this business.
errors.invalidOrigin: Refresh the page and try again.
errors.alreadyExists: That identifier or number is already in use.
errors.serverError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.metaVerificationFailed: Meta couldn’t verify this number. Check the account ID, number ID, and token permissions.
errors.invalidInvitation: This invitation has expired or has already been used.
errors.signInFirst: An account already exists for this invitation. Sign in with that account, then reopen the invitation.
errors.notFound: This conversation is no longer available.
errors.replyWindowClosed: The reply window has ended. Wait for a new customer message.
errors.requestConflict: This reply request has already been used. Refresh the conversation.
errors.analysisNotConfigured: Ask your administrator to configure an OpenRouter API key with access to Claude Haiku 5.5.
errors.analysisUnavailable: Analysis could not finish. Try again later; your messages are still available.
errors.analysisInvalid: The AI response could not be verified. The previous analysis was kept.
errors.analysisRateLimited: The AI service is busy. Try again shortly.
errors.analysisNoText: There are no recent customer text messages to analyze.
errors.analysisBusy: This conversation is already being analyzed. Refresh shortly.
errors.analysisChanged: Messages or business categories changed during analysis. Please analyze again.
errors.enrollmentExpired: This link has expired. Ask the business for a fresh link.
errors.enrollmentLinkWait: A link was recently created for this conversation. Wait one hour before creating another.
errors.enrollmentLocked: This verification link has reached its limit. Ask the business for a fresh link.
errors.codeWait: Wait one minute before requesting another code.
errors.codeWindowClosed: Send a WhatsApp message to this business first, then request the code again.
errors.codeSendFailed: The code could not be sent. Ask the business to check its WhatsApp connection.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is incorrect, expired, or already used.
errors.customerSessionExpired: Open a fresh link from the business and verify your number to continue.
errors.copyManually: Select and copy the link manually.
errors.templateUnavailable: Approved templates could not be loaded. Check the WhatsApp connection.
errors.campaignSenderMissing: Choose a connected Datamine sender first.
errors.campaignLocked: This offer can no longer be edited.
errors.templateLanguage: The template must use the same language as the offer.
errors.campaignNotReady: Wait for audience matching to finish before sending.
errors.templateChanged: The approved template changed. Choose a current template before sending.
errors.audienceChanged: Customer preferences changed. Matching is running again automatically.
errors.audienceEmpty: No eligible customers match this offer yet.
errors.audienceLimit: This demo supports up to 100 eligible customers per language.
errors.metaTokenExpired: The WhatsApp connection has expired. Update its access token to continue.
errors.metaTemplatePermission: This WhatsApp connection does not have permission to manage templates.
errors.templateSubmitFailed: Meta could not accept this template. Check the message and try again.
errors.templateSubmissionUnknown: Meta did not confirm the submission. Try submitting the same text again; Datamine checks for an existing template first.
errors.campaignReplyWindowClosed: Ask a matched customer to send a new WhatsApp message to the selected sender, then try again. Replies require an open 24-hour chat window.

passwordChanged: Your password has been updated. Other sessions were signed out.
passwordChangeError: Password update failed. Check your current password and try again.

crm.sampleHint: Try replies and edits. Sample changes reset when you leave this inbox.
crm.privateHint: Conversations stay private to this business.
crm.noAgency: Add a business to open its inbox.
crm.emptyHint: Incoming WhatsApp messages will appear here once a number is connected.
crm.searchHint: Try a different search or status.
crm.chooseConversation: Every conversation starts with a hello.
crm.chooseHint: Select a conversation to view the messages and customer details.
crm.unsupported: {type} message · media preview is not available yet
crm.uncertainHelp: Sending could not be confirmed. Check WhatsApp before sending again.
crm.failedHelp: WhatsApp rejected this message. Check the connection before trying again.
crm.sampleReplyHint: Practice here. Demo replies are never sent to WhatsApp.
crm.viewerHint: You have view-only access to this inbox.
crm.windowClosed: The reply window has ended. Ask the customer to send a new message, or use an approved offer template.
crm.detailsHint: Filled automatically from messages. Your manual corrections are kept.
crm.noteHint: Only your business can see this. It is not sent to the customer.

inboxSub: Read, reply, and keep customer requests together.

ai.title: Customer insights
ai.hint: Haiku updates categories and details automatically as messages arrive.
ai.demoHint: Prepared insights for the original sample conversation.
ai.setup: AI is not connected yet. Your administrator can enable it with an OpenRouter API key.
ai.stale: Update this analysis for the latest messages, business categories, or selected language.
ai.sampleResult: Prepared sample · no AI request was made. Added demo replies are not analyzed.
ai.reviewHint: Details update automatically. Manual corrections are kept until you restore automatic details.

ava.summary: The customer wants two return tickets from Erbil to Istanbul for October 22–28, with a morning departure.
ava.nextStep: Check morning flight options and confirm the travel year.
ava.reviewNote: The travel year and budget were not stated.

rebaz.summary: The customer asks which documents are required for a Dubai tourist visa.
rebaz.nextStep: Clarify their circumstances before sharing the relevant requirements.
rebaz.reviewNote: Travel dates and traveler count were not stated.

noor.summary: The customer will confirm travel dates with their family.
noor.nextStep: Wait for the customer to confirm the dates.
noor.reviewNote: The available message does not specify a service or destination.

dilan.summary: The customer asks about a three-seat sofa and delivery to Erbil.
dilan.nextStep: Share available sofas and check the delivery area.
dilan.reviewNote: The budget and delivery date were not stated.

ai.retrying: Analysis will retry automatically. Existing details are kept.
ai.awaitingConsent: Waiting for WhatsApp consent before AI analysis.

customersSub: The central Datamine list of customers who chose to join.
businessTypeHint: e.g. Furniture store, clinic, or travel
categoriesHint: Haiku chooses categories from each conversation. Optional hints help keep names consistent; separate them with commas (up to 12).
businessSettingsHint: Describe the business to give Haiku context. Categories and customer details are chosen automatically.

enrollment.inviteHint: Invite this customer to the Datamine network. Joining is their choice.
enrollment.linkHint: Send this link through your usual reply. It expires in 24 hours. Verification needs a recent customer WhatsApp message.
enrollment.title: Stay connected, your way.
enrollment.intro: Verify your WhatsApp number, then choose whether to join the Datamine customer network.
enrollment.preferencesHint: Choose your interests and keep your preferences up to date.
enrollment.demoHint: Sample only. No WhatsApp message is sent, and no real customer is enrolled.
enrollment.verifyHint: We’ll send a code from {business} to the WhatsApp number ending {phone}.
enrollment.verificationOnly: Verifying your number does not sign you up. You decide in the next step.
enrollment.codeSent: Code sent. Check WhatsApp. You can request another code after one minute.
enrollment.codeUncertain: Delivery is not confirmed. Check WhatsApp before requesting another code.
enrollment.privacy: Your business chats and private team notes are not shared with the customer network.
enrollment.name: Full name
enrollment.interestsHint: Separate interests with commas. Up to 12, in any language.
enrollment.consent: I agree to Datamine saving and analysing my messages with AI, learning my interests and sending relevant WhatsApp promotions.
enrollment.consentDetails: One consent covers message collection, AI analysis and promotional enrollment. Your AI-derived interests may match offers from Datamine and participating businesses. Raw chats and private team notes are not shared with other businesses. Reply STOP to remove your saved chat and profile and block future collection.
enrollment.enrolled: You’re part of the Datamine customer network.
enrollment.optedOutHint: You’re opted out of Datamine offers. Your record is kept to remember this choice.
enrollment.optOutNote: This affects Datamine offers. It does not change your direct conversations with businesses.
enrollment.returnHint: This verified session lasts 30 minutes. To return later, request a fresh opt-in link from the business and verify your number again.
enrollment.directoryHint: Only consenting customers appear here. Interests update from AI analysis of their chats; raw chats and private notes stay private.
enrollment.noProfilesHint: Customers appear after consenting in WhatsApp.
enrollment.demoDirectory: Explore sample profiles or try the opt-in flow. Demo preferences stay in this browser tab only.
enrollment.consentAccepted: Enrolled. STOP OFFER blocks the last offered topic. STOP ends the service and removes saved data.
enrollment.consentPending: Waiting for the customer to reply YES to the WhatsApp notice. NO removes the held chat and blocks collection.
enrollment.consentDeclined: Consent withdrawn. Saved chats and interests are removed.
enrollment.consentFailed: The consent notice could not be confirmed. Analysis and offers stay paused.

campaignsTitle: The right offer. The right people.
campaignsSub: Submit an offer. Haiku finds relevant customers who chose to join.

offers.demoHint: Prepared demo · matching and delivery are simulated. No real customer receives a message.
offers.automaticHint: Haiku understands each offer and matches it to customers’ chosen interests automatically.
offers.aiSetup: Add the OpenRouter API key to enable automatic matching.
offers.senderHint: Choose the central Datamine WhatsApp number that customers agreed could send them offers. Customers can reply STOP to this number.
offers.emptyHint: Submit a product, service, or promotion for automatic matching.
offers.demoDraftHint: This is a saved sample draft. New matching needs a connected AI account; the prepared example shows how results look.
offers.templateHint: Choose a template or create one below.
offers.matchingHint: Haiku is finding relevant customers automatically. This page updates when ready.
offers.retrying: Matching will retry automatically when possible.
offers.audienceCount: {count, plural, one {# matched customer} other {# matched customers}}
offers.consentHint: Consenting customers only. Opt-outs are excluded.
offers.reviewHint: Datamine reviews the audience and sends the approved message. Customer contact details remain with Datamine.
offers.submitHint: Describe the real offer clearly. Haiku decides its categories and audience automatically.
offers.title: Offer title
offers.templatePendingHint: Approval is checked automatically. Open chats can receive normal replies while this template is in review.
offers.templateSenderHint: Connect a Datamine sender to create templates.
offers.templateDraftHint: Haiku drafts a message from this offer. Check the wording and make any changes before submitting.
offers.templateReviewHint: Meta reviews marketing templates. This submits the template for approval; it does not send a message to customers.
offers.replyReady: Ready to send now · {count, plural, one {# customer} other {# customers}}
offers.replyReadyHint: Real WhatsApp replies from {sender}. No template approval is needed while these 24-hour chat windows are open. Only eligible customers will receive this offer.
offers.replyNeedsMessage: A fresh customer message is needed
offers.replyNeedsMessageHint: Before presenting, ask the customer to message {sender}. Their 24-hour reply window will open and this page will update automatically. An approved template can reach customers outside that window.
offers.networkHint: One relevant offer automatically. More only on request.

businessLoginHelp: Share this link with the business owner. They choose their password.
